text: Once I’m attached, “I’m taking a chance on her” starts turning into “she’s the right person” after we’ve been together for a while. Based on what? Sometimes I actually learned something, and sometimes nothing changed except that now I’m attached, so the new certainty is just harder for me to question.
reader: Someone a few weeks into a relationship, deciding whether their growing certainty about the person is earned.
